svg.metadata: {"id": "s074", "name": "晚餐餐桌", "cat": "家庭生活", "tags": ["营养", "饮食习惯", "家庭", "餐桌礼仪"], "desc": "傍晚的家庭餐桌：暖黄吊灯下摆着鱼、青菜、番茄炒蛋、米饭和冒热气的汤，窗外晚霞，右侧餐边柜。", "stand": {"ground_y": 960, "x": [420, 1500]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "wall", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "window", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.25, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "frames", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.4, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "sideboard", "enter": "slide-r", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "floor", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "chairs", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.4, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "table", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.55, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "dishes", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.75, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "steam", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "flow", "depth": null}, {"name": "pendant", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.6, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "lamp_glow", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "plant", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.9, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}], "palette": {"wall1": "#E7EEDD", "wall2": "#D5E1C8", "wains": "#A9805F", "wains2": "#8E6849", "floor1": "#BC875D", "floor2": "#9E6D47", "table": "#C99260", "table2": "#A6733F", "cloth": "#FFF8EE", "runner": "#F2B9A6", "plate": "#FFFFFF", "plate2": "#E8ECEF", "fish": "#F2A35E", "fish2": "#E08A45", "veg": "#6DB46F", "veg2": "#9AD18E", "egg": "#F7D35E", "tom": "#E8604F", "rice": "#FFFDF6", "bowl": "#7FB8D8", "bowl2": "#5E9CC0", "soup": "#F4C56A", "lamp": "#FFD98A", "shade": "#E8835E", "chair": "#8E5B36", "chair2": "#744828", "side": "#B98A63", "side2": "#9A6E4A", "sky1": "#3E4F82", "sky2": "#E9A48A", "star": "#FFF1C2", "fruit1": "#F28C2E", "fruit2": "#E8483B", "fruit3": "#F7D35E", "frame": "#FFFFFF", "leaf": "#5FA873", "leaf2": "#93CC8E", "pot": "#E9DFD0"}}
